scope: Updated operational acceptance registry for the same 42 engineering/research issues. Historical registries remain evidence only and may not overwrite this latest state.

items.acceptance_item: 淘汰临时100场/最佳数据500作为模型裁决集
items.evidence: Neutral fixed1000 is the research comparison set; 100-match slices remain diagnostic only.

items.acceptance_item: 基准成员资格与市场赔率可得性解耦
items.evidence: V6.13.1 membership uses identity+90m result only; market availability cannot control membership.

items.acceptance_item: 固定1000场精确样本量
items.evidence: benchmark_n=1000.

items.acceptance_item: 17个正式赛事域全部进入固定基准
items.evidence: competition_count=17.

items.acceptance_item: 每赛事域最近两个可用赛季
items.evidence: season_strata_count=34; two_seasons_each_domain=true.

items.acceptance_item: 确定性分层抽样且不按预测正确性选样
items.evidence: Hamilton proportional allocation + SHA256 identity rank.

items.acceptance_item: 冻结成员资格与SHA-256可复现
100场只做波动诊断，不做模型晋级
items.evidence: 200 deterministic 100-match slices showed 36%-63% accuracy range; promotion never uses A100.

items.acceptance_item: 所有候选在同一固定1000上比较
items.evidence: All retrospective challenger comparisons use the immutable V6.13.1 membership; track-specific coverage stays explicit.

items.acceptance_item: 命中率同时报告Wilson区间
items.evidence: Wilson intervals are persisted for full/selective 1X2 evaluations and forward gates.

items.acceptance_item: Log Loss纳入硬指标
items.evidence: Log Loss is a hard nonworsening gate; V6.47.7 was held because total log loss regressed.

items.acceptance_item: Brier纳入硬指标
items.evidence: Brier remains in market/1X2 and matrix comparison audits.

items.acceptance_item: RPS纳入硬指标
items.evidence: Total/ordinal RPS is a hard nonworsening gate.

items.acceptance_item: 概率校准/ECE纳入审计
items.evidence: Market top1 ECE=0.0078869; calibration is audited separately from argmax frequency.

items.acceptance_item: 覆盖率、联赛/方向/置信区间分组审计
items.evidence: Coverage and domain/direction/confidence stratification are persisted; V6.47.4 also caps domain concentration.

items.acceptance_item: Top-1改善但proper score恶化时自动拦截
items.evidence: V6.13.2 held old matrix candidates; V6.47.7 was also held despite some improvements because total log loss/Top1 regressed.

items.acceptance_item: 市场盲模型在固定1000生成完整预测
items.evidence: Result-only Elo baseline produces 1000/1000 predictions across 17 domains.

items.acceptance_item: 纯市场轨在固定1000独立评估并显式报告不可得覆盖
items.evidence: Pure-market track is independently evaluated on 926/1000 available rows; KOR_KLeague1 and UEFA_ChampionsLeague historical market absence is explicit and does not remove them from benchmark membership.

items.acceptance_item: 融合轨在固定1000独立评估
items.evidence: Predeclared blend curve is evaluated on identical common rows; no benchmark-chosen runtime blend weight.

items.acceptance_item: 市场盲/纯市场/融合三轨同场逐行对比
items.evidence: V6.46.2/4 use the same common identities and hash-validated cached predictions.

items.acceptance_item: 识别模型是否只是在学习市场残差
items.evidence: Simple market-blind Elo does not add independent proper-score value; fusion is not forced.

items.acceptance_item: 单一联合矩阵、概率守恒与市场/模型协调不得凭空造比分
items.evidence: V6.47.7/8 rebuild totals/scores as direct T plus conditional D|T, enforce parity/integer mapping, probability conservation residual ~1e-16, and keep formal weight 0 until forward validation.

items.acceptance_item: 废止未重校准的单一63%门槛，选择器必须预冻结/分层可靠性
items.evidence: V6.47.4 trains hierarchical reliability on 16,407 strictly earlier rows and tests frozen threshold on fixed1000; V6.47.5 starts a new no-backfill forward epoch.

items.acceptance_item: 平局概率校准与Top-1平局频率分离
items.evidence: Probability calibration is independent from argmax draw frequency.

items.acceptance_item: 真实平局率与平均P(draw)偏差审计
items.evidence: Fixed benchmark market subset: actual draw rate=0.25810, mean P(draw)=0.25536, bias=-0.00274.

items.acceptance_item: 平局Brier纳入审计
items.evidence: draw Brier=0.188806.

items.acceptance_item: 平局Top-1 precision/recall只作诊断
items.evidence: Low draw argmax recall is not used as a reason to inflate draw probability.

items.acceptance_item: 禁止强制增平/人工平局改写
items.evidence: Forced draw rewrites remain prohibited; research selector can SELECT/ABSTAIN but does not rewrite probabilities.

items.acceptance_item: 任何新平局上下文只能经严格OOS/真实前向挑战
items.evidence: V6.47 team-context contract requires exact-match pre-freeze evidence; unverified context abstains that feature, and no draw-context weight can enter CURRENT without a new forward gate.

items.acceptance_item: 17域336队周度PIT底库
items.evidence: 336-team / 17-domain static discovery layer remains present.

items.acceptance_item: 当前阵容覆盖必须区分严格完整名单与可运行静态上下文
items.evidence: V6.47.1: strict complete current roster=335/336; Troyes official UEFA page explicitly says official squad list not available yet, but 22-player current first-team active group is official. Operational static context=336/336, gap=0; no false complete-roster claim.

items.acceptance_item: 伤停/停赛/交易/深度不得用永久336队静态完整率冒充比赛时点状态
items.evidence: V6.47.2 resolves availability per exact match and freeze time. Missing/stale fields trigger live pre-freeze lookup; unresolved fields abstain individually and do not poison an independent market-only track.

items.acceptance_item: 主教练状态在比赛冻结时点验证
items.evidence: Manager cache is context-only; missing/stale manager must refresh at match freeze under V6.47.2.

items.acceptance_item: 换帅事件按比赛时点delta验证而非要求336队永久存在换帅记录
items.evidence: Manager-change is treated as an event delta; absence of a cached event is never interpreted as verified no-change without live freeze-time resolution.

items.acceptance_item: 周扫后至单场冻结时点的delta刷新
items.evidence: V6.47.2 hard contract requires same-day delta resolution for stale/missing roster, manager, availability, predicted XI and material transfers before grading match context.

items.acceptance_item: available_at/observed_at防未来泄漏
items.evidence: V6.31/V6.47 reject post-freeze/post-kickoff evidence and forbid actual-lineup backfill into predicted XI.

items.acceptance_item: 已知开放代码缺陷清零
items.evidence: Known resolver/workflow defects found during this remediation were fixed, including V6.31 filename routing and stale roster source-of-truth precedence.

items.acceptance_item: 赛果解析/身份结算链稳定性
items.evidence: K LEAGUE official AJAX fallback resolved 6/6 prior unresolved fixtures; official-result-only settlement remains enforced.

items.acceptance_item: A100降为诊断门，不再作为晋级前置裁决
items.evidence: 100-match runs remain fast diagnostics only; true promotion requires post-freeze forward samples.

items.acceptance_item: 固定基准减少重复抓取并提升复现/速度
items.evidence: Fixed1000 prediction cache is keyed by benchmark SHA + model-config SHA; invalidation is explicit.

items.acceptance_item: 1X2真实冻结前向样本达到晋级门
items.evidence: V6.47.4 strictly earlier-development selector scored 208/322=64.60% on fixed1000 market-available rows, coverage=34.77%, Wilson90 lower=60.11%. V6.47.5 froze a NEW epoch at 2026-07-28T02:02:42Z, rejected 82 old predictions as before_epoch, and requires >=100 newly settled selected matches plus quality/domain gates.

items.acceptance_item: 总进球/比分统一矩阵真实前向达到联合门
items.evidence: V6.47.8 nominated total=competition-only / margin=full after capacity isolation: total metrics equal stable reference while exact-score Top1=12.2%, Top3=31.5%, score log loss=3.01665 vs 3.05024 reference. V6.47.9 froze a NEW no-backfill epoch at 2026-07-28T02:28:41Z and requires >=100 newly settled paired matches with proper-score nonworsening.

remaining_non_engineering_constraints: F05 cannot be closed before future post-2026-07-28T02:02:42Z matches are genuinely predicted and settled.
